## Libraries and house style

```{r libraries-and-style}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(cowplot)
library(lemon)
library(gridExtra)
library(gtable)
library(patchwork)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)

FONT_FAMILY    <- "Helvetica"
FONT_SIZE_PT   <- 7
FONT_SIZE_GEOM <- FONT_SIZE_PT / .pt
TAG_SIZE_PT    <- 7.5
GG_LINE_UNIT_PT  <- 0.75 * 72.27 / 25.4
pt_to_ggline     <- function(x) x / GG_LINE_UNIT_PT
SECONDARY_LINE_PT <- 0.25
AXIS_LINE_PT      <- 0.50
PRIMARY_LINE_PT   <- 0.75
LINE_SIZE       <- pt_to_ggline(SECONDARY_LINE_PT)
ERROR_LINE_SIZE <- pt_to_ggline(AXIS_LINE_PT)
AXIS_LINE_SIZE  <- pt_to_ggline(AXIS_LINE_PT)
DATA_LINE_SIZE  <- pt_to_ggline(PRIMARY_LINE_PT)
TICK_LENGTH_PT <- 2.5
POINT_SIZE     <- 1.8
POINT_STROKE   <- 0.53
INTERVAL_HIGHLIGHT_FILL <- "#EBEBEB"
# Native publication width. Compressing the panel geometry should not alter
# physical type or stroke sizes; place the exported PDF at this native width.
FIGURE_WIDTH_IN  <- 5.75
FIGURE_HEIGHT_IN <- 5.727273
FIGURE_X_SHIFT <- 25 / (FIGURE_WIDTH_IN * 72)
TOP_ROW_X_SHIFT <- -23 / (FIGURE_WIDTH_IN * 72)
LOWER_ROW_X_SHIFT <- -16 / (FIGURE_WIDTH_IN * 72)

RATING_LIMITS <- c(1, 5)
RATING_BREAKS <- seq(1, 5, 1)
SUMMARY_RATING_LIMITS <- c(3, 5)
SUMMARY_RATING_BREAKS <- seq(3, 5, 0.5)
CONFIDENCE_X_LIMITS <- c(0.85, 4.22)
ATTRITION_X_LIMITS <- c(0.85, 3.15)
ATTRITION_PANEL_RATIO <- diff(ATTRITION_X_LIMITS) / diff(CONFIDENCE_X_LIMITS)
ATTRITION_PANEL_LEFT_SPACER <- 0.007

GROUP_LEVELS <- c("AI", "AI Human", "Human")

GROUP_COLORS <- c(
  "AI" = "#0173B2",
  "AI Human" = "#029E73",
  "Human" = "#DE8F05"
)

GROUP_LABELS <- c(
  "AI" = "AI",
  "AI Human" = "AI + Human",
  "Human" = "Human"
)

GROUP_SHAPES <- c(
  "AI" = 21,
  "AI Human" = 22,
  "Human" = 24
)

theme_figure6 <- function() {
  theme_classic(base_family = FONT_FAMILY, base_size = FONT_SIZE_PT) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(family = FONT_FAMILY, size = FONT_SIZE_PT),
      axis.line = element_line(colour = "#000000", linewidth = AXIS_LINE_SIZE),
      axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "#000000", linewidth = AXIS_LINE_SIZE),
      axis.ticks.length = grid::unit(TICK_LENGTH_PT, "pt"),
      axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = FONT_SIZE_PT),
      axis.text.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 3)),
      axis.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = FONT_SIZE_PT),
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = FONT_SIZE_PT,
        margin = margin(t = 6, b = 1)
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5, size = FONT_SIZE_PT,
        margin = margin(b = 3)
      ),
      plot.tag = element_text(size = TAG_SIZE_PT, face = "bold"),
      plot.tag.position = c(0.01, 0.97),
      legend.title = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_PT),
      legend.text = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_PT),
      legend.key = element_blank(),
      legend.background = element_blank(),
      legend.key.width = grid::unit(6, "pt"),
      legend.key.height = grid::unit(7, "pt"),
      legend.spacing.y = grid::unit(0.5, "pt"),
      legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_PT),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4)
    )
}
```

## Data and summaries

```{r data-and-summaries}
summarise_mean_ci <- function(data, value, group_vars) {
  data %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(group_vars))) %>%
    summarise(
      mean = mean(.data[[value]], na.rm = TRUE),
      sd = sd(.data[[value]], na.rm = TRUE),
      n = sum(!is.na(.data[[value]])),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      se = sd / sqrt(n),
      ci95 = qt(0.975, df = pmax(n - 1, 1)) * se
    )
}

data_raw <- read_excel(
  "../Study_2_FollowUp_Results/MAR/data/Study_2_Full_Data.xlsx"
)
data_filtered <- data_raw %>%
  filter(stage1_task0_accuracy < 0.9) %>%
  mutate(followup_complete = !is.na(follow_task0_confidence))

confidence_long <- data_filtered %>%
  select(
    ID,
    Label,
    `Stage 1` = stage1_task0_confidence,
    `Stage 2` = stage2_task0_confidence,
    `Stage 3` = stage3_task0_confidence,
    `Follow-up` = follow_task0_confidence
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`Stage 1`, `Stage 2`, `Stage 3`, `Follow-up`),
    names_to = "Phase_short",
    values_to = "Confidence"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Phase_short = factor(
      Phase_short,
      levels = c("Stage 1", "Stage 2", "Stage 3", "Follow-up")
    ),
    Label = factor(Label, levels = GROUP_LEVELS)
  )

confidence_summary <- summarise_mean_ci(
  confidence_long,
  value = "Confidence",
  group_vars = c("Label", "Phase_short")
) %>%
  mutate(
    x_plot = as.numeric(Phase_short)
  )

make_attrition_summary <- function(data, sample_label) {
  confidence_long <- data %>%
    select(
      ID,
      `Stage 1` = stage1_task0_confidence,
      `Stage 2` = stage2_task0_confidence,
      `Stage 3` = stage3_task0_confidence
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(`Stage 1`, `Stage 2`, `Stage 3`),
      names_to = "Phase_short",
      values_to = "Confidence"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Phase_short = factor(
        Phase_short,
        levels = c("Stage 1", "Stage 2", "Stage 3")
      ),
      Sample = sample_label
    )

  summarise_mean_ci(
    confidence_long,
    value = "Confidence",
    group_vars = c("Sample", "Phase_short")
  )
}

attrition_summary <- bind_rows(
  make_attrition_summary(data_filtered, "All participants"),
  make_attrition_summary(
    data_filtered %>% filter(followup_complete),
    "Follow-up completers"
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    Phase_short = factor(
      Phase_short,
      levels = c("Stage 1", "Stage 2", "Stage 3")
    ),
    Sample = factor(
      Sample,
      levels = c("All participants", "Follow-up completers")
    ),
    x_plot = as.numeric(Phase_short)
  )

make_rating_bundle <- function(stage2_col, stage3_col) {
  all_long <- data_filtered %>%
    select(ID, Label, all_of(c(stage2_col, stage3_col)))
  names(all_long) <- c("ID", "Label", "Stage 2", "Stage 3")

  all_long <- all_long %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c("Stage 2", "Stage 3"),
      names_to = "Phase",
      values_to = "Rating"
    ) %>%
    drop_na(Rating) %>%
    mutate(
      Label = factor(Label, levels = GROUP_LEVELS),
      Phase = factor(Phase, levels = c("Stage 2", "Stage 3"))
    )

  all_summary <- summarise_mean_ci(
    all_long,
    value = "Rating",
    group_vars = c("Label", "Phase")
  )

  completer_long <- data_filtered %>%
    filter(followup_complete) %>%
    select(ID, Label, all_of(c(stage2_col, stage3_col)))
  names(completer_long) <- c("ID", "Label", "Stage 2", "Stage 3")

  completer_long <- completer_long %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c("Stage 2", "Stage 3"),
      names_to = "Phase",
      values_to = "Rating"
    ) %>%
    drop_na(Rating) %>%
    mutate(
      Label = factor(Label, levels = GROUP_LEVELS),
      Phase = factor(Phase, levels = c("Stage 2", "Stage 3"))
    )

  completer_summary <- summarise_mean_ci(
    completer_long,
    value = "Rating",
    group_vars = c("Label", "Phase")
  )

  list(
    raw = all_long,
    all = all_summary,
    completers = completer_summary
  )
}

willingness <- make_rating_bundle(
  "stage2_task0_willing",
  "stage3_task0_willing"
)

usefulness <- make_rating_bundle(
  "stage2_task0_useful",
  "stage3_task0_useful"
)
```

## Panels b and c: Stage 2 versus Stage 3 ratings

```{r rating-panels}
make_rating_plot <- function(bundle, panel_tag, panel_title, y_title = NULL) {
  ggplot(bundle$raw, aes(x = Phase, y = Rating)) +
    geom_line(
      aes(group = ID),
      colour = "grey82",
      alpha = 0.65,
      linewidth = LINE_SIZE
    ) +
    annotate(
      "segment",
      x = 1, xend = 2,
      y = 3, yend = 3,
      linetype = "dashed",
      colour = "grey55",
      linewidth = LINE_SIZE
    ) +
    geom_linerange(
      data = bundle$all,
      aes(x = Phase, ymin = mean - ci95, ymax = mean + ci95, colour = Label),
      linewidth = ERROR_LINE_SIZE,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = bundle$all,
      aes(x = Phase, y = mean, group = Label, colour = Label),
      linewidth = DATA_LINE_SIZE,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = bundle$all,
      aes(x = Phase, y = mean, shape = Label, fill = Label, colour = Label),
      size = POINT_SIZE,
      stroke = POINT_STROKE,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_linerange(
      data = bundle$completers,
      aes(x = Phase, ymin = mean - ci95, ymax = mean + ci95, colour = Label),
      linewidth = ERROR_LINE_SIZE,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = bundle$completers,
      aes(x = Phase, y = mean, group = Label, colour = Label),
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = DATA_LINE_SIZE,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = bundle$completers,
      aes(x = Phase, y = mean, shape = Label, colour = Label),
      fill = "white",
      size = POINT_SIZE,
      stroke = POINT_STROKE,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    facet_wrap(
      ~Label,
      nrow = 1,
      labeller = as_labeller(GROUP_LABELS)
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = GROUP_COLORS, breaks = GROUP_LEVELS) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = GROUP_COLORS, breaks = GROUP_LEVELS) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = GROUP_SHAPES, breaks = GROUP_LEVELS) +
    scale_x_discrete(
      labels = c("Stage 2" = "2", "Stage 3" = "3"),
      expand = expansion(add = 0.75)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = RATING_LIMITS,
      breaks = RATING_BREAKS,
      expand = expansion(mult = 0)
    ) +
    coord_capped_cart(bottom = "both", left = "both", gap = 0.01) +
    labs(
      tag = panel_tag,
      title = panel_title,
      x = "Stage",
      y = y_title
    ) +
    theme_figure6() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.spacing = grid::unit(4, "pt"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 2)),
      plot.tag.position = c(0.01, 0.97),
      plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 1, 4)
    )
}
```

## Compact p-value rows

```{r p-value-rows}
format_p <- function(p) {
  if (length(p) != 1 || !is.finite(p)) {
    stop("A figure annotation did not resolve to one finite P value.")
  }

  if (p < 0.001) {
    "italic(P)~'< 0.001'"
  } else {
    sprintf("italic(P)~'= %.3f'", p)
  }
}

extract_full_sample_p <- function(measure) {
  result_path <- paste0(
    "../Study_2_Main_Results/results/H2/",
    "H2_Within_Task_Attitude_Perceptions.xlsx"
  )
  sheet <- paste0(measure, "_Posthoc_Stage_Label")

  result <- read_excel(result_path, sheet = sheet) %>%
    filter(
      .data$contrast == "stage3 - stage2",
      .data$Label %in% GROUP_LEVELS
    ) %>%
    mutate(Label = factor(.data$Label, levels = GROUP_LEVELS)) %>%
    arrange(.data$Label)

  if (nrow(result) != length(GROUP_LEVELS) || any(!is.finite(result$p.value))) {
    stop(sprintf(
      "Could not recover the three %s P values from %s [%s].",
      measure, result_path, sheet
    ))
  }

  setNames(result$p.value, as.character(result$Label))
}

fit_completer_p <- function(measure) {
  completer_long <- data_filtered %>%
    filter(.data$followup_complete) %>%
    mutate(
      Label = factor(.data$Label, levels = GROUP_LEVELS),
      Used_LLM_Hours = case_when(
        .data$Used_LLM_Hours == "0" ~ "None",
        .data$Used_LLM_Hours %in% c("1–5", "6–10") ~ "Low",
        .data$Used_LLM_Hours %in% c("11–20", ">20") ~ "High",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      Used_LLM_Hours = droplevels(factor(
        .data$Used_LLM_Hours,
        levels = c("None", "Low", "High")
      ))
    ) %>%
    select(
      ID, Label, Age, Gender, Field, Used_LLM_Hours,
      matches(paste0("^stage[23]_task[1-3]_", measure, "$"))
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = matches("^stage[23]_task[1-3]_"),
      names_to = "fullvar",
      values_to = "Value"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Phase = str_extract(.data$fullvar, "^stage[23]"),
      Task = str_extract(.data$fullvar, "task[1-3]"),
      Phase = factor(.data$Phase, levels = c("stage3", "stage2")),
      ID = factor(.data$ID),
      Task = factor(.data$Task)
    )

  model <- lmer(
    Value ~ Phase * Label + Age + Gender + Field + Used_LLM_Hours +
      (1 | ID) + (1 | Task) + (1 | ID:Task),
    data = completer_long
  )

  result <- as.data.frame(
    pairs(emmeans(model, ~ Phase | Label))
  ) %>%
    filter(
      .data$contrast == "stage3 - stage2",
      .data$Label %in% GROUP_LEVELS
    ) %>%
    mutate(Label = factor(.data$Label, levels = GROUP_LEVELS)) %>%
    arrange(.data$Label)

  if (nrow(result) != length(GROUP_LEVELS) || any(!is.finite(result$p.value))) {
    stop(sprintf(
      "Could not calculate the three completer-only %s P values.",
      measure
    ))
  }

  setNames(result$p.value, as.character(result$Label))
}

willing_p_all <- extract_full_sample_p("willing")
willing_p_completers <- fit_completer_p("willing")
useful_p_all <- extract_full_sample_p("useful")
useful_p_completers <- fit_completer_p("useful")

make_p_table <- function(values_all, values_completers) {
  p_data <- data.frame(
    AI = values_all[1:1],
    AI_Human = values_all[2:2],
    Human = values_all[3:3],
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  p_data[2, 1:3] <- values_completers

  p_theme <- ttheme_minimal(
    base_family = FONT_FAMILY,
    base_size = FONT_SIZE_PT,
    core = list(
      fg_params = list(hjust = 0.5, x = 0.5, parse = TRUE),
      bg_params = list(fill = "white", col = NA),
      padding = grid::unit(c(0.75, 1.5), "mm")
    )
  )

  tbl <- tableGrob(
    p_data,
    rows = NULL,
    cols = NULL,
    theme = p_theme
  )

  tbl$widths <- grid::unit.c(
    grid::unit(1, "null"),
    grid::unit(1, "null"),
    grid::unit(1, "null")
  )

  tbl
}

table_c <- make_p_table(
  vapply(willing_p_all, format_p, character(1)),
  vapply(willing_p_completers, format_p, character(1))
)

table_d <- make_p_table(
  vapply(useful_p_all, format_p, character(1)),
  vapply(useful_p_completers, format_p, character(1))
)

table_c_plot <- ggdraw() +
  draw_grob(table_c, x = 0, y = 0.02, width = 1, height = 0.72) +
  draw_line(
    x = c(0.092, 0.908), y = c(0.90, 0.90),
    colour = "grey55", size = LINE_SIZE
  ) +
  draw_label(
    "All", x = -0.13, y = 0.56, hjust = 0,
    fontfamily = FONT_FAMILY, size = FONT_SIZE_PT
  ) +
  draw_label(
    "Completers", x = -0.13, y = 0.20, hjust = 0,
    fontfamily = FONT_FAMILY, size = FONT_SIZE_PT
  )

table_d_plot <- ggdraw() +
  draw_grob(table_d, x = 0, y = 0.02, width = 1, height = 0.72) +
  draw_line(
    x = c(0.092, 0.908), y = c(0.90, 0.90),
    colour = "grey55", size = LINE_SIZE
  )

```

## Combine and export

```{r combine-and-export}
top_row <- (panel_a | plot_spacer() | panel_b) +
  plot_layout(
    widths = c(
      1,
      ATTRITION_PANEL_LEFT_SPACER,
      ATTRITION_PANEL_RATIO
    )
  )

lower_design <- "
AB
CD
"

lower_row <- fig23 + fig24 + table_c_plot + table_d_plot +
  plot_layout(
    design = lower_design,
    widths = c(1, 1),
    heights = c(1, 0.24)
  )

top_canvas <- ggdraw() +
  draw_plot(top_row, x = TOP_ROW_X_SHIFT, y = 0, width = 1, height = 1)

lower_canvas <- ggdraw() +
  draw_plot(lower_row, x = LOWER_ROW_X_SHIFT, y = 0, width = 1, height = 1)

combined_rows <- plot_grid(
  top_canvas,
  lower_canvas,
  ncol = 1,
  rel_heights = c(0.92, 1.08)
)

combined_figure <- ggdraw() +
  draw_plot(
    combined_rows,
    x = FIGURE_X_SHIFT,
    y = 0,
    width = 1,
    height = 1
  )

print(combined_figure)

ggsave(
  "figure/Figure_Study2_2.pdf",
  combined_figure,
  width = FIGURE_WIDTH_IN,
  height = FIGURE_HEIGHT_IN,
  device = cairo_pdf,
  family = FONT_FAMILY,
  symbolfamily = FONT_FAMILY,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  "figure/Figure_Study2_2.png",
  combined_figure,
  width = FIGURE_WIDTH_IN,
  height = FIGURE_HEIGHT_IN,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  "figure/Figure_Study2_2.svg",
  combined_figure,
  width = FIGURE_WIDTH_IN,
  height = FIGURE_HEIGHT_IN,
  bg = "white"
)
```
